was: Three campground loops (Magnolia 1, Magnolia 2, Hickory) within walking distance of the spring; sewer only in Magnolia 1, and Hickory's sites are sold as tent-only. Glamping sites in Hickory Loop are booked through the park's concessionaire. --Claude

was: City of Silver Bay campground on Lake Superior's North Shore, beside Black Beach Park, with an ATV trail from the campground. The nearest boat launch is at the Silver Bay Marina, about 5 miles south. --Claude
